verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 4.102
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 4.102

verses.pali: 11. Valāhakavagga
verses.english: 11. Clouds

verses.pali: Dutiyavalāhakasutta
verses.english: Clouds (2nd)

verses.pali: “Cattārome, bhikkhave, valāhakā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these four kinds of clouds.

verses.pali: Katame cattāro?
verses.english: What four?

verses.pali: Gajjitā no vassitā,
verses.english: One thunders but doesn’t rain,

verses.pali: vassitā no gajjitā,
verses.english: one rains but doesn’t thunder,

verses.pali: neva gajjitā no vassitā,
verses.english: one neither thunders nor rains, and

verses.pali: gajjitā ca vassitā ca.
verses.english: one both rains and thunders.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro valāhakā.
verses.english: These are the four kinds of clouds.

verses.pali: Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, cattāro valāhakūpamā puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: In the same way, these four individuals similar to clouds are found in the world.

verses.pali: Katame cattāro?
verses.english: What four?

verses.pali: Gajjitā no vassitā,
verses.english: One thunders but doesn’t rain,

verses.pali: vassitā no gajjitā,
verses.english: one rains but doesn’t thunder,

verses.pali: neva gajjitā no vassitā,
verses.english: one neither thunders nor rains, and

verses.pali: gajjitā ca vassitā ca.
verses.english: one both rains and thunders.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo gajjitā hoti, no vassitā?
verses.english: And how does an individual thunder but not rain?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dhammaṁ pariyāpuṇāti—
verses.english: It’s when an individual memorizes the teaching—

verses.pali: suttaṁ, geyyaṁ, veyyākaraṇaṁ, gāthaṁ, udānaṁ, itivuttakaṁ, jātakaṁ, abbhutadhammaṁ, vedallaṁ.
verses.english: statements, mixed prose and verse, discussions, verses, inspired exclamations, legends, stories of past lives, amazing stories, and elaborations.

verses.pali: So ‘idaṁ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti, ‘ayaṁ dukkhasamudayo’ti yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti, ‘ayaṁ dukkhanirodho’ti yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti, ‘ayaṁ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti.
verses.english: But they don’t truly understand: ‘This is suffering’ … ‘This is the origin of suffering’ … ‘This is the cessation of suffering’ … ‘This is the practice that leads to the cessation of suffering’.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo gajjitā hoti, no vassitā.
verses.english: That’s how an individual thunders but doesn’t rain.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, valāhako gajjitā, no vassitā;
verses.english: That individual is like a cloud that thunders but doesn’t rain, I say.

verses.pali: tathūpamāhaṁ, bhikkhave, imaṁ puggalaṁ vadāmi.
Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo vassitā hoti, no gajjitā?
verses.english: And how does an individual rain but not thunder?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dhammaṁ na pariyāpuṇāti—
verses.english: It’s when an individual doesn’t memorize the teaching …

verses.pali: suttaṁ, geyyaṁ, veyyākaraṇaṁ, gāthaṁ, udānaṁ, itivuttakaṁ, jātakaṁ, abbhutadhammaṁ, vedallaṁ.
So ‘idaṁ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti …pe… ‘ayaṁ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti.
verses.english: But they truly understand: ‘This is suffering’ …

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo vassitā hoti, no gajjitā.
Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, valāhako vassitā, no gajjitā;
tathūpamāhaṁ, bhikkhave, imaṁ puggalaṁ vadāmi.
Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo neva gajjitā hoti, no vassitā?
verses.english: And how does an individual neither thunder nor rain?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo neva dhammaṁ pariyāpuṇāti—
verses.english: It’s when an individual doesn’t memorize the teaching …

verses.pali: suttaṁ, geyyaṁ, veyyākaraṇaṁ, gāthaṁ, udānaṁ, itivuttakaṁ, jātakaṁ, abbhutadhammaṁ, vedallaṁ.
So ‘idaṁ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti …pe… ‘ayaṁ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti.
verses.english: Nor do they truly understand: ‘This is suffering’ …

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo neva gajjitā hoti, no vassitā.
Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, valāhako neva gajjitā, no vassitā;
tathūpamāhaṁ, bhikkhave, imaṁ puggalaṁ vadāmi.
Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo gajjitā ca hoti vassitā ca?
verses.english: And how does an individual both thunder and rain?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dhammaṁ pariyāpuṇāti—
verses.english: It’s when an individual memorizes the teaching …

verses.pali: suttaṁ, geyyaṁ, veyyākaraṇaṁ, gāthaṁ, udānaṁ, itivuttakaṁ, jātakaṁ, abbhutadhammaṁ, vedallaṁ.
So ‘idaṁ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti …pe… ‘ayaṁ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti.
verses.english: And they truly understand: ‘This is suffering’ …

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo gajjitā ca hoti vassitā ca.
Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, valāhako gajjitā ca vassitā ca;
tathūpamāhaṁ, bhikkhave, imaṁ puggalaṁ vadāmi.
Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro valāhakūpamā puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmin”ti.
verses.english: These four individuals similar to clouds are found in the world.”

verses.pali: Dutiyaṁ.
